$P(\text{Accident}) = P(\text{Accident} | \text{Wet}) \times P(\text{Wet}) + P(\text{Accident} | \text{Dry}) \times P(\text{Dry})$

$P(\text{Accident}) = 0.002 + 0.0016$
$P(\text{Accident}) = 0.0036$
